verdict.rationale: AI Gateway softens provider failures indirectly. It retries failed requests on other providers, falls back to its own system credentials when a BYOK request fails, and lets you pass different credentials per request, so key spreading is possible only if your application handles it. Nothing in the evidence shows rate-limit-aware load balancing across a key pool, or any request queuing or throttling. Missing for 10: native multi-key pooling or round-robin across keys, request queuing, throttling or rate shaping, explicit handling of provider 429 rate-limit errors, independent corroboration.
